inputs.style:
Symphonic heavy metal with a galloping, rhythmic drive similar to classic power metal. The arrangement features driving double-bass drums, galloping sixteenth-note guitar riffs, and lush orchestral strings. The mood is dramatic, gothic, and epic. Vocals alternate between a soaring, operatic female lead and harsh, low male growls. The production is polished with wide reverb on the highs and tight, punchy low-end.
Choose the complete song's natural length and structure yourself. There is no required target duration. The safety ceiling is 900 seconds, not a goal to fill. Compose a coherent intro, verses, chorus and resolved final outro with final chord decay and silence. Finish all sung words and then end the song naturally. No endless loop or unfinished solo. Write explicit measures, no repeat signs.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
(Male Growl)
Dust upon the velvet seat
Silence in the hollow heart
Shadows dancing on the wall
Waiting for the dawn to start

(Female Soprano)
The clock strikes twelve, the candles die
A whisper slips beneath the eye
I wear the mask of porcelain
Hiding the sorrow, hiding the pain

[Chorus]
(Female Soprano)
Oh, the phantom calls my name
Through the corridors of flame
I am the ghost in the machine
Beneath the frozen heaven

(Male Growl)
Screaming!

[Verse]
(Male Growl)
Bones of kings in the crypt below
Echoes of a war long ago
The orchestra plays its final tune
Under a moon of silver ruin

(Female Soprano)
Your cold hand touches my cheek
A promise that we cannot break
The music swells, the strings will tear
The veil of night, the morning air

[Chorus]
(Female Soprano)
Oh, the phantom calls my name
Through the corridors of flame
I am the ghost in the machine
Beneath the frozen heaven

(Male Growl)
Forever!

[Bridge]
(Female Soprano)
Fly, my wings of broken glass
Shatter the mirror, let the past
Unravel, unravel

(Male Growl)
Unravel!

(Guitar Solo)

[Chorus]
(Female Soprano)
Oh, the phantom calls my name
Through the corridors of flame
I am the ghost in the machine
Beneath the frozen heaven

(Male Growl)
Release!

[Outro]
(Female Soprano)
Marble tears... on the floor...
Silence... once more...

(Orchestral Hit)
